description: This file defines a data model and a singleton-like static utility for managing device authentication tokens, including storing, loading, and clearing tokens in a JSON file within the filesystem.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: A Codable and Sendable structure representing an authentication token entry with associated role, scopes, and timestamp.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a token for a given deviceId and role, returning the corresponding DeviceAuthEntry if available.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores or updates a token for a given deviceId, role, token, and optional scopes, returning the created DeviceAuthEntry.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes a token for the specified deviceId and role if it exists.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims whitespace from each scope, filters out empty strings, removes duplicates, and sorts them.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Determines the URL path for the storage file based on device identity paths.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and decodes the JSON store from the filesystem, returning nil if unable.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes and writes the store to the filesystem, creating directories if needed, and sets permissions.
